rubric.role_summary: Senior/Staff offensive security software engineer developing web application penetration-testing content for an autonomous pentesting platform, including testing customer applications and translating findings into product improvements.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior/Staff offensive security software engineer developing web application penetration-testing content for an autonomous pentesting platform, including testing customer applications and translating findings into product improvements.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Senior/Staff-level experience combining extensive web application penetration testing with software development.
- Experience conducting web application penetration tests.
- Experience with web proxy tools such as Burp Suite.
- Proficiency in object-oriented programming.
- Familiarity with relational databases such as Postgres.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience developing software and automation for web application pentesting.
- Background in large-scale software development projects.
- Experience fine-tuning language models or implementing RAG for security applications.
- Experience with AI/LLM tools for agentic workflows and contextual-data integration; named tools and protocols are examples.
- Demonstrated use of AI to enhance or automate exploit development.
- OSCP certification.
- Experience conducting full-scope web application penetration tests.
- Experience with proxy tools such as Burp and with browser developer tools.
- Proficiency in object-oriented programming and test-driven development.
- Experience applying AI-assisted development tools to security research and automation tasks.
- Skill in designing and evaluating technical solutions across systems, APIs, algorithms, and data structures.
- Familiarity with relational and graph databases; Postgres and Neo4j are highlighted examples, not individually required.
- Recognized security research, including documented CVE discoveries and responsible disclosure.
- Track record of successful bug bounty contributions.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: US (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
